reason: The hypothesis proposes a new quantitative screening metric (ΔF/F) derived from ab initio lattice dynamics to predict low thermal conductivity, which is not suggested in any passage. It synthesizes the finding from P2/P6 that force-constant fluctuations dominate scattering in FeCoCrMnNi with a predictive framework, and extends it to a class of FCC HEAs with similar masses but diverse bonding, a transfer not proposed in the literature. The falsification test comparing computed ΔF/F with measured conductivity across multiple alloys is also new.
